verdict.rationale: The evidence documents time-based Automations and scheduled tasks, which are recurring schedules rather than event-triggered rules. It also documents Python Filter functions that can intercept messages, but those are developer building blocks a user would code, not a rule-definition feature. The personal webhook is a fixed 'response ready' notification, not user-defined event-to-action rules, so nothing in the pack shows the product itself lets users define rules that fire actions on events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
